thread.title: Citi: AAPL predicted to hit $200 with compelling holiday season iPhone lineup and continued services growth

author: Benjamin Mayo
title: Citi: AAPL predicted to hit $200 with compelling holiday season iPhone lineup and continued services growth
text: Citi: AAPL predicted to hit $200 with compelling holiday season iPhone lineup and continued services growth By Benjamin Mayo Jul 2, 2018, 9:48 am 115 pts For those that follow the stock market, Apple’s share price dropped from record highs over the last month, falling from $194 to circa $185 levels amidst trade war jitters and some news of lower iPhone production levels. Tim Cook says he doesn’t worry about short-term stock price moves, but…
